snippet.title: Scarlet Hollow Episode 5 Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Episode 5 is releasing on February, Friday the 13th, Valentine's Eve.

The first four episodes of Scarlet Hollow are available now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1609230/Scarlet_Hollow

Play the entire first episode for free in the demo!

Many thanks to our dear friends at @SmallButera for animating this!
